meanings: To arrive/come/enter in the evening, Afternoon [counted from noon to sunset] (or noon to midnight), evening, after sunset, I came to him in the evening, He came to him in the evening with such a thing.

occurrences.verseTransliteration: Fe subhânallâhi hîne tumsûne ve hîne tusbıhûn(tusbıhûne).
